{{Otheruses|Amphitheater}}
The '''Amphitheater''' was the location in the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] where outdoor plays were performed. The structure was designed to complement its natural surroundings in the hillside of the [[Garden/Legends|gardens]] and was built of stone and clay.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
